title: Main Street Fair Saturday, free San Pedro dance fest, pumpkins after dark
intro: Street-fair Saturday is the big one this weekend. El Segundo closes Main Street for the Kiwanis fair, San Pedro puts twenty dance companies on the grass at Peck Park free, and Magic of the Jack O'Lanterns keeps glowing at South Coast Botanic Garden. Cards below. We left parking, food, and prices blank unless we could confirm them on an official page.

picks.name: El Segundo Main Street Fair
picks.address: Main Street, downtown El Segundo (eight blocks closed)
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free admission. Kid Activity Zone (inflatables, rides, petting zoo, pony rides) and food priced individually — amounts not listed on the Kiwanis page. Beer garden is the adult zone.
picks.parking: Official Kiwanis page does not list parking rates. Street closures on Main; park nearby and walk.
picks.food: Food court and local restaurant fair deals on site. Prices vary.
picks.why: Eight blocks of crafts, a dedicated kids zone, food, and live music. Kiwanis fundraiser for local kids.

picks.name: San Pedro Festival of the Arts
picks.address: Peck Park Upper Green near Community Center, 560 N Western Ave
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free. Picnic welcome.
picks.parking: Official festival page does not list parking rates.
picks.food: Bring a picnic (official). Vendor details not listed.
picks.why: Free outdoor dance festival with about 20 companies on the grass. All ages.

picks.name: Magic of the Jack O'Lanterns
picks.when: Select nights Friday, September 25–Sunday, September 27 (season runs select nights through November 1; timed tickets)
picks.address: South Coast Botanic Garden, 26300 Crenshaw Blvd (use this address — apps may misroute)
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: ticket prices vary by night and tier. Live cart prices were not readable from the official LA pages this week — confirm in the ticket widget before you buy. Parking cost not listed on the LA event page (ignore Denver/Hudson Gardens parking copy on other MOTJ pages).
picks.parking: Official LA page does not list a parking fee for South Coast Botanic Garden. Use 26300 Crenshaw Blvd.
picks.food: Food and beverages on site (official). Cashless event. Optional s'mores area.
picks.why: Mile-long trail of carved glowing pumpkins plus Fun Zone bounce pad and slides. Still early in the season.

picks.name: Baja Splash Cultural Festival
picks.address: Aquarium of the Pacific, 100 Aquarium Way
picks.cost_math: 2 adults (12+) + 2 kids (3–11): $49.95 + $49.95 + $34.95 + $34.95 = $169.80 entry. Under 3 free. Members free with reservation. Plus $8 validated Aquarium parking ≈ $177.80. Reservations required.
picks.parking: Aquarium parking structure: $8 flat with Aquarium validation.
picks.food: Aquarium cafes / nearby Pike & Shoreline Village; festival page does not break out food prices.
picks.why: Dance, live music, and bilingual programs celebrating cultures of México, Central and South America. Included with general admission.

picks.name: Salt Marsh Open House at Cabrillo
picks.address: Salinas de San Pedro / Cabrillo Beach area — Cabrillo Marine Aquarium, 3720 Stephen M. White Drive
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free program (aquarium suggested donation $10 adult / $5 child — not required). Parking: $3/hr, $9 daily max, card only → about $9 if you stay for the program.
picks.parking: Cabrillo Beach lot: $3/hr, $9 daily max, credit/debit only.
picks.food: Official calendar does not list food. Picnic areas in Cabrillo Coastal Park.
picks.why: Binoculars and magnifiers to explore the salt marsh. Calm outdoor nature for all ages (kids with an adult).

picks.name: South Bay Legends Memorial Free Surf Contest
picks.when: Sunday, September 27, 2026 (contest day; registration closes Friday September 25 11:59 p.m.)
picks.address: El Porto, 42nd Street
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free to enter (official). Shortboard, foam, and grom divisions including Push-In ages 1–8. Beach games all day noted by organizers.
picks.parking: Official signup page does not list parking rates. El Porto street parking gets tight.
picks.food: Official page does not list food. Pack snacks or eat nearby.
picks.why: Free all-ages memorial surf contest at El Porto with beach games. Great if your kids already surf or just want to watch.

picks.name: National Public Lands Day at White Point
picks.address: White Point Nature Preserve, 1600 W. Paseo del Mar
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free volunteer morning. Pre-register on PVPLC VolunteerHub. Under 18 needs a guardian release; under 16 with an adult. Native plant sale 10:30 a.m.–12:00 p.m. and guided garden tour 11:00–11:30 a.m. same morning (free to attend; plants for purchase).
picks.parking: Free lot via Western Ave to Paseo del Mar; overflow oceanside / White Point–Royal Palms (PVPLC).
picks.food: Official listing does not list food. Eat first or pack light.
picks.why: Habitat care plus children’s activities on public lands day. Easy same-morning plant sale and garden tour add-on.

picks.name: Manhattan Beach Hometown Fair
picks.when: Saturday–Sunday, October 3–4, 10:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. (parade Saturday 10:00 a.m.)
picks.address: Live Oak Park, Dorsey Field & Joslyn Center / Valley Drive area
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free admission. Kid Country (petting zoo, inflatables, shows) free per attractions page. Food and paid games extra.
picks.parking: Official site notes parking is challenging; accessible parking at Civic Center Lot (Highland & 15th, placard) first-come.
picks.food: Nonprofit food booths on Dorsey/Live Oak fields. Prices not listed.
picks.why: Flagship free hometown fair with Kid Country. Mark the calendar — no tickets, but crowds are real.

picks.name: ArtLab: Día de los Muertos at Marine Mammal Care Center
picks.address: Marine Mammal Care Center, 3601 S. Gaffey St
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free. Max 35; reserve on Eventbrite. All ages; kids with an adult. Supplies provided.
picks.parking: Official listing does not list parking rates.
picks.food: Official listing does not list food.
picks.why: Marine-mammal science lesson + patient tour + alebrije art. Same Saturday as the MB fair — pick one or go early to ArtLab.

picks.name: Downtown San Pedro Night Market
picks.address: 300 W 6th St
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free admission. Food and shopping extra (prices unknown).
picks.parking: Official event page does not list parking rates.
picks.food: Local food vendors on site. Prices vary.
picks.why: Evening street market with music and vendors downtown. Easy weeknight out with kids.

picks.name: Festa Italiana Los Angeles
picks.when: Saturday, October 10, 11:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m. (live entertainment from about 3:00 p.m.)
picks.address: 6th St between S. Palos Verdes & S. Centre (nav: 222 W 6th St)
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free entry and entertainment. Food and merch paid. Topaz Garage on Centre (5th–6th) $10 flat Saturday 10:30 a.m.–midnight; street meters $0.50/half-hour before 6 p.m. → entry $0 + parking about $10 if you use the garage.
picks.parking: Street first-come; Topaz Building garage on Centre St $10 flat Sat 10:30 a.m.–midnight (official FAQ).
picks.food: 20+ Italian food vendors; kids games and photo experiences; beer garden for adults. Dogs on leash OK.
picks.why: Big free Italian street festa with kids activities. Strong October Saturday in San Pedro.

picks.name: Scaredown in Downtown Torrance
picks.address: Old Torrance (Discover Torrance lists 1313 Sartori Ave on the event page; Halloween guide shows 1266 Sartori — confirm before you go)
picks.cost_math: Discover Torrance lists trunk-or-treat, games, live bands/DJ, and marketplace. No admission price stated — treat as unknown.
picks.parking: Official listing does not list parking rates. Old Torrance street parking.
picks.food: Marketplace and food implied; prices unknown.
picks.why: Early Halloween downtown — trunk-or-treat and games for families. Same Saturday as MB Hometown Fair.

picks.name: Friday Fun at Madrona Marsh
picks.when: Friday, September 25, 10:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m. (also Fridays ongoing, e.g. Oct 2)
picks.address: Madrona Marsh Nature Center, 3201 Plaza del Amo
picks.cost_math: Free. Pre-register Tuesday 10:00 a.m. the same week: (310) 782-3989; first 20.
picks.parking: Nature Center lot. Official page does not list a fee.
picks.food: Official page does not list food.
picks.why: Hands-on preschool nature (story, science, art, tour).

picks.name: Public Fish Dissection at Cabrillo
picks.address: Cabrillo Marine Aquarium, 3720 Stephen M. White Drive
picks.cost_math: Free demos; no registration. Aquarium suggested donation optional. Parking up to $9/day card only.
picks.parking: Cabrillo Beach lot: $3/hr, $9 daily max, card only.
picks.food: Official calendar does not list food.
picks.why: All-ages anatomy demos. Skip if your kids are squeamish.

picks.name: Family Science Sunday at Marine Mammal Care Center
picks.when: Sunday, September 27 — sessions at 11:00 a.m., 1:00, 2:00, and 3:00 p.m. (1 hour each)
picks.address: 3601 S. Gaffey St, Suite #8
picks.cost_math: $1 booking fee per person = $4 for four. Free MMCC admission otherwise. Promo MMCARE if hardship.
picks.parking: Official page does not list parking rates.
picks.food: Official page does not list food.
picks.why: Ocean and marine-mammal science plus patient viewing.

picks.name: Oktoberfest Torrance bounce houses (Mom Said Yes)
picks.address: 4525 Calle Mayor
picks.cost_math: Free entry; bounce houses free. Beer-pong tournament is 21+ only — skip that part.
picks.food: Pretzels and beer cheese all day; pizza venue. Prices unknown.
picks.why: Daytime family slice of Oktoberfest with free bounce houses. Stay out of the 21+ tournament.

picks.name: Bird Walk at Madrona Marsh
picks.address: Madrona Marsh, 3201 Plaza del Amo
picks.cost_math: Free. All ages; kids welcome with adults. Pre-reg optional: (310) 782-3989.
picks.parking: Nature Center lot. Official page does not list a fee.
picks.food: Official page does not list food.
picks.why: Beginner-friendly bird walk for mixed ages.

picks.name: RPV Trunk or Treat
picks.address: Ken Dyda Civic Center, 30940 Hawthorne Blvd
picks.cost_math: Free. Free parking plus shuttle from Point Vicente Interpretive Center.
picks.why: City trunk-or-treat with inflatables and parade. Tickets aren't needed — crowds will be.

picks.name: San Pedro Día de los Muertos Festival
picks.address: Downtown San Pedro, 396 W 6th St
picks.cost_math: Free admission. Food vendors on site (prices unknown).
picks.why: Watch list — altars, folklórico, vendors, Catrina contest downtown.

picks.name: Hermosa Beach Pumpkins in the Park
picks.cost_math: Listed on the Hermosa city calendar for Oct 10, 11:00 a.m.–1:00 p.m. Address and cost unconfirmed on a fetched official detail page this week — re-check city calendar before you go.
picks.why: Pumpkin decorating and costume parade historically — confirm city detail page.

picks.name: Cabrillo Sea Scare: Monsters of Myth
picks.address: Cabrillo Marine Aquarium, 3720 Stephen M. White Drive
picks.cost_math: Ticketed evening event (presale numbers seen elsewhere; confirm live on CMA before buying). Parking up to $9. Ages 3+ typical.
picks.why: Watch list — aquarium Halloween with trick-or-treat and haunted house. Confirm prices on CMA.
